title: Granger Farwell's house at 1623 Prairie, from its 1886 drawing
items: 1623 Prairie is no longer a grey draft box: Granger Farwell's stone house now stands there, built from its architects' 1886 drawing — a round-arched window over a rusticated base, the door up its stoop, and a canted oriel of tall leaded lights across the second floor.
Why 1623: the 1890 photograph of the McBirney house at 1625 shows Farwell's oriel right next door to the north.
